new_value.evidence_summary: USDD does not operate a bridge (has_bridge_surface: false). No per-window outflow rate-limiter documented for USDD protocol contracts. The June 2022 depeg recovery via $2B reserve deployment demonstrates TDR has a market-intervention capability, but this is economic intervention, not a code-level rate-limiter. TRON blockchain has emergency validator pause capability in principle (Tron Foundation controls supernodes) but is not a published USDD protocol-level mitigant. Yellow: partial positive mitigant exists (TDR reserve intervention) but no code-level rate-limiter confirmed.
